title: The Man Who Bought an Entire Airport for $1
sources: BBC News / The Guardian (2014): Manston Airport in Kent, UK, closed April 2014 by owners Ann Gloag and Stagecoach; purchased by millionaire Charlie Sherwood for £1 (one pound) later in 2014 after the previous owner could not give it away
Kent Online / This Is Money (2014): 'Millionaire buys Manston Airport for £1' — Sherwood paid a nominal £1 for the 170-acre site and the airport's debts, saying he planned to reopen it
Wikipedia: 'Manston Airport' — closed 15 May 2014; sold for £1 to Charles Morley Sherwood; site later subject to compulsory purchase order debate for cargo hub
